post.description:
## Overview
Submits Leave Details Form to the business.

## Authentication
**Available for Client Tokens only.**

## Required Fields
Before submitting, call `GET /client_api/v1/portals/{business_uid}/contact/get_form` to discover required fields for the business's form configuration.

For the default `leave_details` form, `subject` and `message` are typically required fields. Any field marked with `required: true` in the form response must be provided with a non-empty value, or the API returns HTTP 422.

## Request Body Structure
The `form_data.fields` object is a dynamic map where keys are field IDs and values are the field values. Field IDs can be obtained from the GET form response.

parameters.name: business_uid
parameters.description: business_uid

form_data.description: Form data containing field values. This is an object (NOT an array) with a 'fields' property.

fields.description: Dynamic map of field IDs to values. Field IDs include fixed keys like 'subject' and 'message', plus any custom field IDs from the form configuration. Get valid field IDs from GET /client_api/v1/portals/{business_uid}/contact/get_form.

example.subject: Contact inquiry
example.message: Hello, I would like more information

isWidget.description: Whether the form was submitted from a widget. **Must be a boolean value (true/false), not a string.**

422.description: Validation Error - Empty or missing required fields. Use GET .../contact/get_form to discover required field IDs.

post.description:
## Overview
Submits Share Documents Form to the business.

## Authentication
**Available for Client Tokens only.**

## Critical Requirement
The `matter_uid` query parameter must reference a matter with an assigned staff member. Without this, the endpoint returns 500 due to a server-side bug.

## Request Format
This endpoint requires `multipart/form-data` format with actual binary file uploads (not JSON). Documents must be uploaded as form fields with proper content types.

## Important: Field Naming Convention
**Document fields MUST use explicit numeric indices** (e.g., `[0]`, `[1]`), NOT empty brackets `[]`.

- Correct: `form_data[fields][documents][0]=@file.pdf`
- Wrong: `form_data[fields][documents][]=@file.pdf` (causes 500 error)

This is because the server expects a Hash structure, not an Array.

## Captcha
When the business has the `captcha_intake_form` feature enabled, a valid `captcha_token` is required.

## Example cURL
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.vcita.biz/client_api/v1/portals/{business_uid}/share_documents_form/submit?matter_uid={matter_uid}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {token}' \
  -F 'form_data[fields][title]=My Document' \
  -F 'form_data[fields][message]=Please review' \
  -F 'form_data[fields][documents][0]=@file.pdf;type=application/pdf'
```

parameters.name: matter_uid
parameters.description: The matter/conversation UID to associate with the document upload. **Critical**: The matter must have an assigned staff member to avoid 500 errors.

form_data[fields][documents][0].description: File to upload. **Important**: Use explicit indices `[0]`, `[1]`, etc. - NOT empty brackets `[]`. For multiple files, use `form_data[fields][documents][0]`, `form_data[fields][documents][1]`, etc.

captcha_token.description: reCAPTCHA token. Required when business has captcha_intake_form feature enabled.

422.description:
Validation Error or Business Blocked.

**Validation Error**: Missing required fields like documents.

**Business Blocked**: When the business is flagged as spammer or user access is blocked, returns 422 with NO explicit error message - only `auto_reply_message` in the data object.

500.description: Internal Server Error. Occurs when the matter does not have an assigned staff member or when an empty JSON body is sent instead of multipart/form-data.

get.description:
## Overview
Searches for docuforms (documents and forms) activities within the business. Results are scoped based on the requesting staff member's permissions.

### Staff Scoping
- **Admin staff** (with full client access): Can see all docuforms activities, unless `teams_view_filter=me` is specified.
- **Non-admin staff**: Can only see their own docuforms activities, unless they have shared view access.

Available for **Staff and Internal tokens**.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search text to match against docuforms data. Defaults to `*` (all) if not provided.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (1-based).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of results per page.

parameters.name: select_all
parameters.description: When set to true, returns all matching docuforms without pagination limits.

parameters.name: teams_view_filter
parameters.description: When set to `me`, restricts results to only the current staff member's docuforms, even if the staff has admin access.

parameters.name: signature_status
parameters.description: Filter by signature status. Common values include: pending, awaiting_signature, sent, signed, declined.

401.description: Unauthorized. The bearer token is missing, invalid, or not allowed to access the requested resource.

504.description: Gateway Timeout. The Seeker search service is unavailable or timed out.

post.description:
Create a new file for the specified business. The API returns immediately with status='pending'. File processing (virus scan, S3 upload, thumbnail generation) happens asynchronously in the background.

If a duplicate file is detected via SHA-256 content hash, the existing file is returned immediately with status='uploaded'.

Rate limit: 10 uploads per user per 10 minutes. Maximum file size: 100MB.

Available for **Staff and Client tokens**.

200.description: Duplicate file detected - existing file returned immediately (no processing needed)

201.description: File upload initiated successfully (new file, async processing started)

400.description: Bad request - Invalid file type, name, or size

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

403.description: Forbidden - Feature disabled for this business

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Validation error in request data

429.description: Too Many Requests - Rate limit exceeded (10 uploads per 10 minutes)

get.description:
Retrieves files for the specified business, optionally filtered by status or a list of file UIDs. Results include pre-signed S3 URLs for file download and thumbnails when the file is ready. Soft-deleted files are never returned.

Available for **Staff and Client tokens**.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by file processing status (e.g., "uploaded", "pending"). Soft-deleted files are never returned regardless of this filter.

parameters.name: file_uids
parameters.description: One or more file UIDs to fetch. Repeat the parameter for multiple values (e.g., "file_123abc", "file_456def").

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of files per page (default: 20, max: 100).

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions to access files for this entity

get.description:
Retrieves a specific file by its unique identifier.

Used for status polling after upload to check if processing (scan, S3 upload, thumbnails) is complete. Response includes pre-signed S3 URLs when file is ready. Permission checks are performed via the Core service and cached for 15 minutes.

Available for **Staff and Client tokens**.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the file to retrieve (e.g., "file_123abc").

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions to access this file

404.description: Not Found - File does not exist

delete.description:
Soft deletes a specific file.

 File will be permanently deleted in 30 days.

Available for **Staff tokens only**.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the file to delete (e.g., "file_123abc").

200.description:
File deleted successfully (soft delete). Returns the deleted file entity.

File will be permanently deleted in 30 days.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions to delete this file

404.description: Not Found - File does not exist

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Validation error in request data

post.description:
Links an existing file to a business entity (e.g., an invoice, message, or appointment). The referenced file must already exist and be in a usable state ('scanned', 'uploaded', or 'linked'). Once a file has at least one active relation its status becomes 'linked', protecting it from cleanup.

For **Client tokens**, the client_uid is derived from the token and any value supplied in the body is ignored. For **Staff tokens**, client_uid may be provided to associate the relation with a specific client.

Available for **Staff and Client tokens**.

400.description: Bad request - File is not ready or is in an unusable state

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

404.description: Not Found - File does not exist

409.description: Conflict - A relation between this file and entity already exists

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Validation error in request data

get.description:
Retrieves the file-entity relations for a given entity, each including the linked file's details. Results are paginated.

Available for **Staff and Client tokens**.

parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.description: Type of entity to fetch relations for (e.g., "invoice", "message", "appointment").

parameters.name: entity_uid
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the entity to fetch relations for (e.g., "inv_123abc").

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of relations per page (default: 20).

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions to access relations for this entity

delete.summary: Delete all relations for an entity
delete.description:
Soft deletes every file-entity relation for the given entity and returns the number of relations deleted. Files left with no remaining active relations may become eligible for cleanup.

Available for **Staff and Client tokens**.

parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.description: Type of entity whose relations should be deleted (e.g., "invoice", "message", "appointment").

parameters.name: entity_uid
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the entity whose relations should be deleted (e.g., "inv_123abc").

200.description: Relations deleted successfully (soft delete). Returns the number of relations removed.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions to delete relations for this entity

counts.description: Total number of matching docuforms activities.

docuforms_activity.description: Array of matching docuforms activity records.

uid.description: Unique identifier of the docuform activity.

type.description: Type of the activity (e.g., invoice, estimate, form).

status.description: Current status of the activity (e.g., sent, viewed).

signature_status.description: Signature status of the document (e.g., pending, awaiting_signature, sent, signed, declined).

created_at.description: The date and time when the activity was created.

DocumentSearchHit.description: A document record returned from search results.

direction.description: Direction of the document (e.g., "business" for outgoing, "client" for incoming). Note: internal "pivot" direction is mapped to "business".

created_at.description: The date and time when the document was created.

error.description: Error message describing what went wrong.

file.description: The file binary content to upload. Maximum size: 100MB.

name.description: Optional filename override. If not provided, the original filename from the uploaded file is used. Maximum length: 255 characters (e.g., "document.pdf", "photo.jpg").

metadata.description: Optional JSON object containing arbitrary key-value pairs for additional file metadata (e.g., {"source": "chat", "conversation_id": "conv_123"}).

file_uid.description: Unique identifier of the file to link (e.g., "file_123abc"). Must reference an existing file in a usable state ('scanned', 'uploaded', or 'linked').

entity_type.description: Type of entity the file is linked to (e.g., "message", "invoice").

entity_uid.description: Unique identifier of the entity the file is linked to (e.g., "inv_123abc").

client_uid.description: Optional client UID to associate with the relation (e.g., "client_789abc"). Ignored for Client tokens, where it is derived from the token.

file_entities.description: Array of file-entity relations, each including the linked file's details

deleted_count.description: Number of file-entity relations that were soft deleted (e.g., 3).

field.description: The field that caused the error (for validation errors)

code.description: The code that caused the error (for validation errors)

message.description: The message that describes the error (for validation errors)

Bearer.description: Provide a valid bearer token in the Authorization header. Example: 'Authorization: Bearer {app_token}'
